records.name: US Federated Foundation
records.notes: Legal name US Federated Foundation Inc. The website on the IRS list did not resolve on two tries (bare domain and www), and no other public page turned up. No summary, categories or interests were written, so the record is held back. The name suggests a foundation, but its type is unknown, so it was not hidden as private. Needs a manual check before any further research.

records.name: We Never Say Never Association
records.notes: Legal name We Never Say Never Association Incorporated. The website on the IRS list now redirects to a piano lessons business, so that site was not treated as this group's. No other public page was found, so no summary, categories or interests were written.

records.name: Wesley Proctor Ministries
records.summary: A Christian nonprofit in Philadelphia that teaches Bible lessons and helps churches and small nonprofits with the paperwork for tax-exempt status.
records.what_you_do: Call the number on the website to get help with a tax-exempt application. The site does not list regular services, classes or meeting times.

first_step.how: Call (215) 474-2717, the number the site lists for help with tax-exempt applications, and ask what the ministry offers.

records.notes: The site says the ministry is based in Philadelphia and mentions a donated building, the Catherine H. Proctor Community Center, but gives no address or hours, so it is not listed as a location. The only date on the page is a 2015 copyright line, which is not evidence. Status is probably_active because the site works but shows no dated items. Membership and worship details are not stated.

records.name: Widow's Mite Foundation
records.summary: A nonprofit that offers grief support, counseling resources and an online community for people who have lost a spouse or family member.
records.what_you_do: Join the online community for people with similar losses, register for the Celebrating You social event, or use the resource pages on the website.

first_step.how: Ask about the online community through the link on the group's website, or register for the Celebrating You social event listed there.

records.notes: Legal name Widows Mite Inc. The site calls it Widow's Mite Foundation, Inc. The site has blog posts and an event registration link, but no dates are shown, and the only year is a 2020 copyright line, which is not evidence. Status is probably_active for that reason. The site says it aims to support African American individuals and families; that is recorded as a stated focus, not a restriction, since the page does not say others are turned away. The Facebook community link was not recorded.

records.name: Womxn Beyond Borders
records.notes: The site returned an empty page on three tries (home page, bare domain and /about), so nothing could be read. No summary, categories or interests were written, so the record is held back. Needs a manual visit or a later retry.

records.name: Blessings Across Borders
records.summary: A nonprofit that gives financial aid and essentials to poor families and widows, sponsors orphaned children, and helps children who cannot afford to attend school.
records.what_you_do: Support the group with a donation, or email to ask how to volunteer or help a family. The site lists no volunteer roles or sign-up steps.

first_step.how: Email blessingsacrossborders@gmail.com and ask how to volunteer or how to help a family in need.

records.notes: The menu lists Upcoming Events and Successful Events, but no event names or dates showed. The 2024 copyright line is not evidence, so status is probably_active on the strength of a working site with no dates. The first fetch reported that the page is served from a preview domain, so the site may not be final. Donations go through a crowdfunding page. Eligibility for its aid is not stated, so no requirements were written. The IRS list gives the address as 542 Foster St Unit B.

records.name: BrightAid Foundation
records.notes: The IRS list spells it Brighaid. The home page and /about page each returned only the page title, with no body text. The title names relief work in Gaza, and no Philadelphia activity was visible, so the verdict is out_of_area on thin evidence. Change to publish if a Philadelphia program is found.

records.name: Dialogue Center for Resilience and Empowerment
records.notes: The group uses the short name DCRE. The site describes programs for girls, women and youth in many places, gives only Pennsylvania as its base, and names no Philadelphia program, event or volunteer role. The IRS list shows a Philadelphia street address. Change to publish only if a local program turns up.

records.name: Grace Canopy Ministries
records.notes: The website field on the IRS list held a value that is not a web address, so it was treated as missing. One search for the name with Philadelphia found no page for this ministry. No summary, categories or interests were written, so the record is held back.

records.name: GW 78 Cares
records.notes: The website on the IRS list did not resolve on two tries (bare domain and www), and no other public page was found. No summary, categories or interests were written, so the record is held back.

records.name: Greenberg Home and School Association
records.notes: Parent association for one school (the site says 'our school' and names Greenberg). Membership and calendar pages were not readable, and no public meeting was visible. Hidden under the brief's rule for one-school parent and booster groups. The owner may want to decide whether single-school parent groups should be listed, since parents are already an audience in the vocabulary.

records.name: Liberia Education Project
records.notes: The site describes education work in Liberia and names no Philadelphia activity. The IRS list address is in Philadelphia, which alone does not make it a local group.

records.name: Mini Montessori Academy
records.notes: The site describes a consulting service for teachers and early childhood educators, with no classes, community program or volunteer role. The IRS list calls it a nonprofit, but the site reads as a business. The site gives a Philadelphia post office box.

records.name: Prayers Unite the World
records.notes: An online service that passes prayer requests to about 200 partner religious communities listed on its site. The site lists no meetings, events or Philadelphia activity. The IRS list gives a Philadelphia address. The partner list was not followed up, since the service does not appear to serve Philadelphia.

records.name: Queen Mary Ministry USA
records.notes: The website on the IRS list did not resolve on two tries, including a spelling correction (queenmaryministryusa.org). One search for the name with Philadelphia found no page for this ministry. No summary, categories or interests were written, so the record is held back.

notes: All 15 IRS groups in this batch were checked. Verdicts: 9 publish (3 with a summary and status probably_active: Wesley Proctor Ministries, Widows Mite, Blessings Across Borders; 6 unknown and held back: US Federated Foundation, We Never Say Never Association, Womxn Beyond Borders, Grace Canopy Ministries, GW 78 Cares, Queen Mary Ministry USA), 4 out_of_area (BrightAid Foundation, Dialogue Center for Resilience and Empowerment, Liberia Education Project, Prayers Unite the World), 1 not_a_group (Mini Montessori Academy), 1 hide private (Greenberg Home and School Association). Budget: both WebSearch calls used, which hit the cap; 23 fetches used. Unresolvable domains: usfederateddevco.com, gw78cares.com, queenmaryministyusa.org (a corrected spelling also failed). The We Never Say Never domain redirects to an unrelated piano business. Womxn Beyond Borders returned empty pages on all three tries. BrightAid returned only its page title, so its verdict is thin. No 403s, bot checks or rate limiting were seen. Owner decision worth a look: single-school parent associations are hidden under the booster-club rule in the brief.
